name: Dragon Man, Reformed Robot
oracle_text:
Flying
Dragon Man's power is equal to the greatest mana value among noncreature permanents you control and noncreature cards in your graveyard.
You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs.
blocked_sentences: Dragon Man's power is equal to the greatest mana value among noncreature permanents you control and noncreature cards in your graveyard.

needs.what: a static value (usable as a set_pt / buff magnitude, i.e. a characteristic-defining power) that evaluates to the greatest mana value among objects matching a selector spanning zones -- here the union of noncreature permanents you control on the battlefield and noncreature cards in your graveyard -- and 0 when nothing matches
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `extreme_value` (with `of: mana_value`, `pick: greatest`) does exactly this but is only in `value_keys` for effects, not in `static_value_keys`; the static magnitudes offer `count`, `max_count_of`, `greatest_commander_mana_value` (commanders only) and `sum`, none of which aggregate mana value over arbitrary objects. A one-shot `pump`/`set_pt` op would not track the board continuously as a CDA must.
